description: The second arm of the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID, app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:96-98: WHEN DFHPF3 moves 'COSGN00C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM - TO here, where line 83 wrote FROM - and performs RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN. The combined relation at line 172 now finds the field populated and leaves it alone, and the XCTL at 175-177 transfers with NO COMMAREA, which is the difference from the option transfer at 152-155 and is exactly the condition COSGN00C's own EIBCALEN = 0 test is looking for. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY never runs on this arm, so nothing writes OPTIONO and the field still holds the image the client re-supplied - statelessness made visible, because the value survives only by having travelled in the payload. WS-MESSAGE stays as the spaces line 79 left in it.
